newsitem.title: USA: Lynch mulling split of company via spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Lynch mulling split of company via spinoff.

text.p: Lynch Corp said on Thursday it was considering the possibility of splitting, through a spinoff, either its multimedia or manufacturing operations.
The company said a spinoff would improve management focus, facilitate and enhance financings and prepare the company for future growth, including acquisitions.
A split would also help realize the company's underlying values, Lynch said.
Lynch is a diversified company with subsidiaries in multimedia, services and manufacturing, and actively seeks acquisitions, mostly in existing business areas.
Its multimedia operations include telephone, personal communication services, cellular, broadcast television and direct television and cable television interests.
Its manufacturing operations were composed of Spinnaker Industries, Lynch Machinery Inc and M-tron Industries Inc, the company said.
